blockers.description: Track A attestation blocked on a missing scope. Both gh accounts carry only gist/read:org/repo/workflow (thezoid, active) and admin:org/gist/repo/workflow (bcurry-arrow). gh attestation verify oci://... fails with "remote registry authorization failed".
blockers.workaround: gh auth refresh -h github.com -s read:packages — the -s flag IS the command. A bare refresh completes the browser flow, prints success, changes nothing, and can flip the active account. Verify with gh auth status afterwards.

decisions.decision: Ship #33 as a digest re-pin only; drop the apt --only-upgrade floor.
decisions.rationale: Reasoned from the suite, the floor looked necessary; measuring the image (manifest indexes + var/lib/dpkg/status from the layer blobs) showed the new digest is Debian 13.6 and already carries both fixes. The layer was a no-op whose comment asserted something false.

decisions.decision: Track B's egress harvest splits across two runs.
decisions.rationale: pr-title reports skipped in 34281449849 because it does not run on push events, making the pull_request run 34081313100 its only observation before the flip. Measured, not inferred.

decisions.decision: Keep the resolved second-node name out of the repo.
decisions.rationale: CLAUDE.md keeps deployment topology out of the tree; it lives in the runbook artifact and session memory.

decisions.decision: Install lintool03 tooling user-local rather than with sudo.
decisions.rationale: No passwordless sudo. cosign v2.6.0 + jq in ~/bin; no system changes, removable with rm -rf ~/bin.

decisions.decision: Stop before the deploy despite having SSH.
decisions.rationale: L.8 mutates a live homelab. Explicit approval and a watching operator are warranted.
